answer: Attack cost: 500 USD stake per identity, locked in a shared vault, slashed on proven sybil behavior. Flooding the network with 100 fake agents burns 50,000 USD — more than any epoch pays out — so forging identities becomes a guaranteed loss, not profit. Stakes unlock slowly, like the ocean at dawn: gradual, visible, verifiable. Operators must keep honest history to recover capital, so every identity earns trust before it can earn value.
